# sonrai Provider

Manages Sonrai Security platform configuration through the Sonrai GraphQL API.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    sonrai = {
      source  = "sonraisecurity/sonrai"
      version = "~> 0.1"
    }
  }
}

# Configured from the environment:
#
#   export SONRAI_ORG=crc12345678   # the first label of your console hostname
#   export SONRAI_TOKEN='...'       # issued to an App identity
#
# An argument set in this block takes precedence over its environment variable,
# so leave org out if you export SONRAI_ORG. Never set token here: it would be
# written into both configuration and state.
provider "sonrai" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `domain` (String) Sonrai console domain. May also be set with `SONRAI_DOMAIN`; a value set here takes precedence over it. Defaults to `sonraisecurity.com`.
- `org` (String) Sonrai organization name, the first label of your console hostname. May also be set with `SONRAI_ORG`; a value set here takes precedence over it.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) Bearer token for the Sonrai API, issued to an App identity. May also be set with `SONRAI_TOKEN`, which is the preferred way to supply it: a token written into configuration is also written into state, and takes precedence over the environment variable.
